units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:1">Sabb. I, 1</cite>, sq., v. <cite ref="B00753"><he>בַּיִת</he></cite>.—<he>מעשר ע׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02188"><he>מַעֲשֵׂר</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 64b:6">Ned. 64ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ארבעה ע׳ סומא וכ׳ …</he> four classes of people are as if dead, the poor man, the blind &c.
<cite ref="Nedarim 41a:2">Ib. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>אין ע׳ אלא בדיעה</he> only he is poor who lacks knowledge.
<cite ref="Ketubot 68a:12">Keth. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ בדעת</he> poor in disposition, illiberal, niggardly.

<cite ref="Psalms 118:1">Ps. CXVIII, 1</cite>) <he>שגובה … עשיר בשורו ואת ע׳ בשיו</he> he collects the debt of man out of the good bestowed upon him, taking from the rich man his ox, from the poor man his lamb.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:13">Lev. R. s. 34</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00490"><he>יַעַן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:24">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵇ</cite> <he>ואם היה ע׳ כופר בו</he> but if his relative is poor, he disowns him; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲנִיִּים</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:15">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 22:24">Ex. XXII, 24</cite>) <he>אמרו … ומי הם עמך אמר להם הע׳</he> Israel asked the Lord, and who are thy people? Said he to them, the poor.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:5">Ab. I, 5</cite> <he>ויהיו ע׳ בני ביתך</he> let the poor be members of thy household.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 71a:3">B. Mets. 71ᵃ</cite> (ref. to Ex. l. c.) <he>עֲנִיֶּיךָ ועֲנִיֵּי עירך וכ׳</he> as between thy own poor (relatives) and the poor of thy town, thy own poor have the first claim &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 106b:13">Keth. 106ᵇ</cite> <he>אף לא בשל ע׳</he> neither may you trade with funds designed for the poor.
Peah I, 2 לפי רוב הע׳ according to the number of poor (dependent on the field corners, פֵּאָה); a. v. fr.—Fem. עֲנִיּה, עֲנִיָּיה.

<cite ref="Ketubot 62b:10">Keth. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ זו לשוא שימרה</he> this poor woman has been waiting (for her husband) in vain. Y. ib. IX, 33ᵃ top <he>מה נעשה באותה הע׳</he> what has been done in that poor woman’s case? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:13">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> <he>פתחו לאותה הע׳</he> open the gate for the poor animal; a. fr.
